subject: Data retention & deletion SLAs — follow-up and clarifications

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Amaya Security Team <sec-team@amaya.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data retention & deletion SLAs — post-demo follow-up

Hi Jordan / Amaya security team,

Great speaking with you this morning — thanks for the time and the detailed questions on retention and backup behavior. Quick recap and the next steps we discussed: 

- What we cover: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA controls, vendor security questionnaire kickoff, and specifics on data retention, deletion SLAs, and backup retention.
- Action items I’ll take: share SOC 2 report, provide a short SLA summary (deletion SLAs, log retention, backups), and kick off the vendor questionnaire route so you can track answers.
- Action items from you: confirm whether backups must be retained for longer than our standard retention, and whether you need deletion confirmation (audit log/evidence) for customer-triggered deletes.

Deliverables timeline:
- By EOD today: SOC 2 report (PDF) + one-page retention SLA summary.
- By EOD tomorrow: link to vendor questionnaire for your security intake (DocuSign/secure form).

If there are any non-standard constraints (e.g., legal/regulatory hold, country-specific retention), flag them and I will loop in our security lead, Neha.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: data-retention-sla-summary.pdf (summary of deletion SLAs, log retention, backups)

Subject: Re: Data retention & deletion SLAs — post-demo follow-up

Thanks Marissa — that timeline works. Couple of clarifying questions before we circulate to our legal/security: 

1) SOC 2: is the report Type II and current through 2026? Can we get the control mapping (which requirements map to SOC 2 controls)?
2) Deletion SLAs: you mentioned "customer-triggered deletions" — does Redwood guarantee physical deletion from backups within X days, or is deletion logical and a separate backup retention window required? We need specifics on: primary store deletion SLA, backup retention periods, and whether deletions are honored in backups or require a retention hold.
3) Logs: what is the default log retention for request/trace logs and audit logs? Are logs stored longer than primary data by default?

We may need evidence for deletions (audit log entries) as part of our vendor onboarding.

Jordan
Jordan Miller
Security Operations Manager | Amaya

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@amaya.com>, Amaya Security Team <sec-team@amaya.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data retention & deletion SLAs — post-demo follow-up

Marissa / Rishi — looping in to provide the technical clarifications Jordan asked for. Draft answers below; we can refine before sending to Amaya.

1) SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report covering common criteria through 12/31/2026. I will attach the PDF (Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf) and include a control mapping doc if they need an itemized mapping to ISO/other frameworks.

2) Deletion semantics: 
- Primary store: customer-triggered deletions are applied logically and result in immediate removal from the active primary data store. We provide deletion confirmation (audit entry) within 24 hours of completion.
- Backups: standard backup retention is 90 days. Backups are immutable (point-in-time snapshots). We do not automatically scrub deleted records from existing immutable backups; instead, deletions are honored going forward. For customers that require deletions from backups (e.g., strict regulatory needs), we offer a managed expunge option under contract — we can accelerate the expunge process and provide evidence, but there is an additional operational lead time (typically up to 30 days) and it triggers ticketed workflow with engineering.

3) Logs: default retention for request/trace logs is 30 days; audit logs are retained 365 days by default. We can extend retention for both on request (configurable) or route logs to customer-managed storage (S3/GCS) for longer retention/archival if required.

4) Evidence: we can provide deletion confirmation (audit log entry) as standard. For backup expunge operations, we provide a certificate of completion and related runbook entries.

Next steps I suggest: Marissa, send the SOC2 PDF and the one-page SLA summary to Jordan and offer the vendor questionnaire link. Jordan — if you confirm that standard backup retention (90 days) is acceptable, we can proceed. If Amaya requires backup expunge capability as part of contract, let us know and we will surface pricing/lead time.

-Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data retention & deletion SLAs — post-demo follow-up

Jordan — thanks for the quick confirmation. Attaching the SOC 2 report and the retention SLA summary per the thread. Summary of key items below for your legal/security review: 

- SOC 2: Type II, cover period through 12/31/2026 (attached PDF).
- Primary deletion SLA: logical deletion applied immediately; deletion confirmation/audit entry provided within 24 hours.
- Backup retention: default 90 days (immutable snapshots). Deletions are not retroactively removed from existing backups; managed expunge from backups is available under contract (up to 30 days operational lead time).
- Logs: request/trace logs retained 30 days by default; audit logs 365 days. Can export to customer-managed storage for longer retention.
- Evidence: we provide standard audit log entries for all deletions; for expunge operations we provide certificate of completion and related artifacts.

Link to vendor questionnaire: https://app.docusign.com/recipient/abc123-vendor-questionnaire (you can complete the standard security intake there; we will auto-route answers to our compliance team).

If Amaya needs backup expunge as a contractual term, let me know and I will connect you with our procurement team for the pricing/lead-time addendum.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a quick call with Neha and Rishi if you want to walk through the technical details.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
